name: Money Heist: Korea - Joint Economic Area
description: Disguised under the shadows of a mask, a crew of desperados band together under the leadership of a criminal mastermind known only as “The Professor” to pull off the biggest heist Korea has ever seen.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Recruited by the Professor for a job of unprecedented proportions, eight thieves storm the Unified Korea Mint. Police pull together a task force.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Seon Woojin waits for a crack in the thieves' operation. An escape plan centered around the retrieval of a hidden smartwatch puts Yun Misun in danger.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The sound of a gunshot shakes up the Mint. Dissent among the thieves reaches new heights as some believe a line has been crossed.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Looking to turn a potential disaster into an opportunity, Woojin presses the Professor to allow medical personnel to enter the Mint.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Cha Moohyuk hurries a plot of his own into action. A key revelation on Woojin's end threatens to unravel the Professor's strategy.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As those outside the Mint panic, Woojin proposes she go inside with a cameraman so the thieves can show the public that the hostages are unharmed.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Woojin shifts her tactics after figuring out the real reason for the heist. Kim Sangman appeals to the thieves with a bold promise.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The hostages set their escape plan into motion while Park Chulwoo calls for backup. Cho Youngmin’s attempt to be the first to leave the mint backfires.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The police interrogate a thief. Sangman steps in to take control of the hostage negotiation. A rescue mission takes place to bring a child to safety.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The thieves offer the hostages a choice between money and freedom. After finding out about his son's love affair, Moscow reveals his past.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: A medical emergency puts the thieves on edge, while the deadline to carry out their plan is cut short. Woojin lures the Professor to a nearby hospital.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The police close in on the thieves as they prepare to transport the money out of the Mint. Fierce protests force Sangman to put his foot down.
